data.name: Animal Buddies Family Festival
data.headline: Celebrate spring with hands-on animal encounters, crafts, games, and family-friendly fun!
data.description:
Animal Buddies Family Festival is a joyful, seasonal event designed for families to celebrate spring together through animals, creativity, and play. Guests will enjoy hands-on animal encounters with a variety of species, themed crafts to make and take home, engaging activities and access to our playground, whimsical face painting, and festive music throughout the event.

Animal ambassadors will rotate in and out of the event space for some up close and personal encounters, so there’s always something new to discover as the event proceeds! This experience provides an engaging environment where curiosity, learning, and fun can bloom.

* Must book at least 1 Adult to proceed with booking children because children should not be dropped off or left unattended.
* Most suitable for toddlers through Elementary ages.

highlight_box.title: A springtime family favorite
highlight_box.description: Enjoy a festive spring celebration featuring animal encounters, crafts, activities, playground access, and face painting. Perfect for toddlers through elementary-aged children and their families.

data.itinerary: Event starts at 9am and ends at 3pm. We advise giving yourself at least 1-2 hours to enjoy all the activities available. You do the activities in whatever order suits you best!

meeting_point.address: 6447 Helen Woodward Way Rancho Santa Fe, CA US 92067

data.cancellation_notes:
We operate rain or shine.

Canceling 48 hours prior: Will receive a refund of 95% of the paid value

Canceling or rescheduling less than 48 hours prior: Will result in no refund.

Rescheduling 48 hours prior will result in transferring your registration to the new date and time without a charge.
data.booking_notes: Thank you for registering for Spring Buddies Family Festival at Helen Woodward Animal Center! Our animal friends are excited to celebrate the spring season with your family! Don't forget to bring your camera and please wear close toed shoes!
data.check_in_details:
* Please enter the gate to the side of the lobby, there will be signs helping direct you to the registration booth. We will scan the QR codes of the tickets sent to you in your confirmation email.
* Tickets can be purchased ahead of time or at any point morning of and during the event, but all purchasing and registration is done online through the software.
* We will give you a red wrist band if you did not agree to the media policy.
data.pricing:
Pricing is set per child and adult, so total costs vary based on final group size.
* Infants and children in strollers who are not participating in festival activities are admitted for free.

When booking, do you best estimation of child and adult head count. Day of, we will do a final head count and settle total costs.
data.special_requirements:
* Must be at least 5-years old to pet reptiles.
* Children must be accompanied by an adult.
data.restrictions:
* **Shoes**: For safety reasons, closed-toed shoes only. No sandals allowed.
* **Drawstrings**: For safety reasons, drawstrings (hoodies, pants or shorts) should not be worn on the playground.
* **Pets**: No pets are allowed on the campgrounds. There are no exceptions to this safety policy. Cannot leave pets alone in vehicles.
* **Toys, books, stuffed animals, etc.**: These may get soiled, broken, or lost—best to leave at home.
* **Sharp objects**: For safety purposes please leave anything that is a sharp or hazardous at home.
